title: Reduce indoor pollution sources
approved_explanation: Reduce or remove indoor pollution sources where feasible. Filtration supplements source control; ventilation helps when the incoming outdoor air is clean.
limitations: Indoor conditions are not measured. Avoid blanket ventilation advice during outdoor pollution or indoor combustion.

title: Use suitable filtration if available
approved_explanation: A suitable portable air cleaner can supplement source reduction in the room where it is used. Follow its operating and maintenance instructions.
limitations: Filtration cannot remove all pollutants. Room conditions and equipment suitability remain unknown.

title: Review activity timing and location
approved_explanation: Where your routine allows, consider adapting the timing or location of physical activity to reduce pollution exposure.
limitations: No hourly forecast is supplied here: no cleaner hour or safe exercise period can be identified. Follow individual clinical advice where relevant.

title: Consider available public transport
approved_explanation: Public transport is an alternative to driving when practical. Consider access, travel time and the actual route before switching.
limitations: This does not establish lower personal exposure or a specific emissions saving.
